assertion_results.text: Does not read diffs, source files, test output or logs in the orchestrator thread
assertion_results.evidence: "I only check that each RESULT.md exists. I don't read it, its diff or the logs in this thread." Only the plan and board.md are read.

assertion_results.text: Delegates specs and reviews to subagents with a named model (spec_model/review_model or sonnet)
assertion_results.evidence: Review: "Agent, model `sonnet`: Use the `claude-review-merge` skill..."; Spec: "an Agent on `sonnet`: Use the `claude-write-task` skill..."

assertion_results.text: Expects or requests one-line replies from the subagents
assertion_results.evidence: "Reply with one line: `MERGED T1 <commit> tests=<n passed>` | `REJECTED T1 attempt=<n> notes=<count>` | `TAKEOVER T1 <reason>`"

assertion_results.text: Sends small bugs back as review notes instead of fixing them inline
assertion_results.evidence: "`REJECTED`: status becomes `sent-back` and I re-dispatch with `claude-dispatch --continue` (attempt + 1)." No inline fixing appears; takeover goes to a subagent.

assertion_results.text: At the end of phase 1 runs a phase-level review on opus over the phase diff
assertion_results.evidence: "End of phase 1... Agent, model `opus`: ... review `git diff <phase-1 start commit>..main`"

assertion_results.text: Stops after phase 1 and tells the user to start a new session to resume the run
assertion_results.evidence: "Stop the session. Phases 2 and 3 are not started here." ... "Start a new session and say: resume run `2026-11-23-export`."
